name: OpenBMB ForgeKernel tops the FIB track of NVIDIA's SOL Bench and Huawei's CANNBench, now live-optimizing a DeepSeek MLA kernel
title: OpenBMB ForgeKernel tops the FIB track of NVIDIA's SOL Bench and Huawei's CANNBench, now live-optimizing a DeepSeek MLA kernel
summary: OpenBMB's self-improving kernel agent writes GPU kernels from math and hardware limits alone, without reference code. It is streaming an attempt to beat expert implementations of DeepSeek V4.1's MLA kernel, with a public results page.

appearances.title: ForgeKernel leads kernel benchmarks and attempts a DeepSeek MLA kernel
appearances.summary: OpenBMB said ForgeKernel has topped the FIB track of NVIDIA SOL Bench and Huawei CANNBench. In a live run, the agent is trying to build a DeepSeek V4.1 MLA kernel from scratch without FlashMLA reference code, using the math and hardware constraints.
